summary: Build practical skills in bid challenges, standstill, evidence and administrative review. Explore the five-day course and strengthen your review process.
lede: Public procurement complaints and remedies training prepares review officers, committee members, procurement staff and auditors to assess supplier challenges fairly. It covers complaint intake and triage, standstill timelines, evidence handling and conflict-of-interest checks, with practical work on case registers, review records and reasoned remedy decisions. The course also addresses transparent reporting and adapting review procedures to an institution’s mandate and capacity.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who receive, assess, oversee or audit public procurement complaints and remedies. It suits people who need a practical review process that can be adapted to their institution's legal mandate and procurement procedures.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with public procurement procedures is recommended. No legal qualification or programming experience is required; bring examples of procurement review procedures or anonymized case records if your organization permits their use.
